我的生活与自然(My Life and nature): 一篇关于自然环境的A2短文:安娜与大卫的经历和小计划。
Anna bought a sweater at the shop yesterday. They took many photos at the city park. Anna and David had great fun there. In fact, the balloon drifted upward until it disappeared behind the clouds.

Last Thursday, Anna and David went to the flower market. The weather was snowy that day. Anna borrowed a book about English from the supermarket. Best of all, sadly, the old bookstore will close next month.
Life is full of small surprises. There are always many people at the city park. Anna learned a lot about English. Best of all, I need three hours of uninterrupted sleep tonight.
David is interested in dancing. Anna hopes to visit London one day. Anna's favorite animal is the rabbit.
